component.name: Blynq
component.summary: Instant clipboard and file synchronization utility

description.p: Blynq is a lightweight cross-platform utility for seamless workflow synchronization across your local network. It allows for instant clipboard sharing, remote system control, and snippet management.

ul.li: Clipboard Sync: Real-time clipboard history shared across all connected devices.
Shared Snippets: Create snippets on one device and access them on all others.
Remote Control: Control media and power states between devices.
File Transfer: Robust local network file transfer.
